review.recipe: Clear amber still stirred Canadian-whisky/maple/curacao cocktail in chilled coupe; no serving ice/foam/carbonation/rim. One orange peel expressed and dropped inside, skin up. No recipe reinterpretation. Actual vessel capacity cannot be established from pixels.
review.personality: Useful household keys and plain Bakelite phone implement the source habit of knowing whom to ask and which door opens when official routes stop answering. Both are full-size recognisable ordinary traces but inferred, not explicit whoYouAre objects or historical artefact claims. Telephone partly occluded by drink; recognition uses the entire visible body+receiver, not a sliver.
review.world: Dark old private reading room, restrained right warm practical and quiet left. Clear glass/still liquid and small hanging tag promising, but broad warm gloss and fine timber pattern remain.
issues: Complete glass306px; full conservative essential glass/paper/telephone-body-and-receiver/keys union440px, exceeds approximately389px maximum-breathing phone window. Physical telephone lead increases full union to493px; no phone PASS.
Proposed702px portrait retains complete visible glass, tag, recognisable phone and both keys; full portrait is not moving phone framing.
Discreet tag65px across versus217px bowl; usable long axis60px at70degrees. Long-name glyph fit deferred; paper must not be inflated.
Broad warm glossy timber reflection/fine grain pattern remains; natural flat low-satin walnut material held.
Phone is recognisable but visually competes in size with the drink. Phone/key habits are grounded in helping/opening routes but remain inferred props, not sufficient proof of moral-code specificity.
